# Calendar Event Manager Skill for Muse

Create macOS Calendar events wired with tiered sound alarms (up to 5, each with its own long distinct sound — Blow, Sosumi, Glass, Ping, Funk) plus three coupled Reminders (TOMORROW, TODAY, and at event time), so you never miss an event across Mac and iOS. Battle-tested AppleScript with strict rules — never `date "STRING"`, −1439 not −1440, mandatory alarm-count verification because failures are silent — and systematic post-creation checks. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: macOS only, AppleScript-based, and it assumes Calendar and Reminders are set up. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
